name: Ork Mob
source: Mord Hive v0.5, pp.073-077 (Ork Mob). Statlines from datasheets pp.075-076; equipment lists p.074; Ork special skills p.076 (see skills.json); Waaagh! Psychic Powers p.077 (see spells.json). Orks/Grots have no sourced racial-maximum profile (ceilings left null). Attack Squigs have a variable 2D6" Movement - a representative fixed value is stored with a note. henchmenTypes.notes: Core of the mob. Subject to Animosity. Bought in groups of 1-5.

specialRules.name: Animosity
specialRules.description: Ork Boyz are subject to the rules for Animosity (see specialRules).

henchmenTypes.notes: No more than two Grotz per Ork (including heroes). Subject to Animosity. Not Orks (count as half a model for Rout tests when taken out of action). Runts (may gain XP but are killed if they roll 'That Lad's Got Talent'). Bought in groups of 1-5.

specialRules.name: Animosity
specialRules.description: Grotz are subject to the rules for Animosity (see specialRules).

henchmenTypes.notes: Never more Attack Squigs than Grotz. VARIABLE MOVEMENT: move 2D6" (representative fixed value stored); never run or charge, but contact on a normal move counts as charging. Minderz: must stay within 6" of a Grot (12" with a Squig Prodder) or go wild. Bomb Squig: if a Grot has a Detonator, squigs can be upgraded to Bomb Squigs for 5 tn (3" blast, S4 at -2 armour on death/detonation). Not Orks (count half for Rout). Animals; never gain experience. Bought in groups of 1-5.

specialRules.name: Animals
specialRules.description: Attack Squigs are animals of a sort and do not gain experience.

specialRules: Ork Mob. Animosity: at the start of the Ork player's turn, roll a D6 for each Ork or Grot Henchman not in hand-to-hand combat; on a 1, roll again on the Animosity chart - 1 'I'Erd Dat!' (charge/shoot the nearest friendly Ork/Grot, or behave as 2-5 if none in reach or nearest is a Hero; no other action this turn), 2-5 'Wud Yoo Say?' (spends the turn hurling insults; may do nothing else but defend in combat), 6 'I'll Show Yer!' (an extra move toward the nearest enemy, charging if able - may move twice this turn). Distasteful Company: Orks may only hire Chrono-Gladiators, Ogryn Bodyguards or Unsanctioned Psykers. | Not Orks: each Grot or Attack Squig taken out of action counts as only half a model for Rout tests. Runts: Grotz may gain XP but are killed if they roll 'That Lad's Got Talent'. | Min warband size 3, max 20. No more than two Grotz per Ork (heroes included); never more Attack Squigs than Grotz. | Orks and Grots have no sourced racial-maximum profile (ceilings left null).
